projects.title: Clinic Queue Manager
projects.summary: A C++ queue management prototype exploring patient check-in order and urgent priority handling.
projects.role: Backend developer · Data structures and algorithms
projects.problem: Manual paper patient lists make it difficult for clinic staff to maintain an accurate check-in order when multiple patients arrive together or urgent cases need priority.
projects.approach: Modeled patient arrivals using standard FIFO queues alongside priority handling for urgent cases, focusing on explicit data structure choices and predictable lookup and completion operations.
projects.outcome: Implemented a C++ prototype supporting patient check-in, urgent priority insertion, record search, and appointment completion.

cover.alt: Concept wireframe illustrating a clinic patient queue sequence and priority status

projects.title: Social Media Agent
projects.summary: A Next.js and Gemini API prototype that generates structured social media drafts from a validated brief for human review.
projects.problem: Drafting social media posts for multiple platforms from a campaign brief often requires repetitive research, formatting, and manual checks across channels.
projects.approach: Validated incoming campaign briefs with Zod before calling the Gemini API to produce structured draft options, keeping a manual review step between generation and publishing.
projects.outcome: Built a prototype workflow generating multiple editable draft options per brief with schema validation before review.

cover.alt: Concept wireframe showing a campaign brief alongside reviewed draft options
